Lesson Summary
Design & Control
Valid investigations require strict control variables (e.g., glucose
volume) to ensure only the independent variable affects the results.
Measure & Process
G Yeast fermentation produces CO2. We measure this accurately
using a gas syringe and repeat to spot anomalies and calculate a
reliable mean rate.
Interpret
The rate of fermentation is enzyme-controlled. It increases with
ob kinetic energy up to an optimum temperature, after which the
enzymes denature and the rate drops to zero.
